pages.title: Soul Heart
pages.text: A Soul Heart still burns with the spirit of its former owner. Right click a Brick Stone Pillar with a Soul Heart in your main hand to ignite it, the heart is consumed. Ignite all eight pillars around a Night Altar to prepare the ritual for the Eye of Abyss. Soul Hearts are also needed for the Somnium Usage Upgrade.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Every Soul Guard drops a Soul Heart when it falls. They roam the Blue Mountains and the Nightgrove of The Abyss, often in groups, and slaying them with Looting can yield an extra heart.
